summary.intent: Implement a parallel batch upload pipeline (Phase 37) for cipher-box, including SDK-level batch upload method and Web Worker-based encryption offloading, then clean up, review, and get the PR merged.
summary.outcome: Phase 37 completed with 2 plans executed across 2 waves: `uploadFiles()` on `CipherBoxClient` with p-limit(3) concurrency, and `encrypt.worker.ts` offloading AES-256-GCM encryption off the main thread. PR #416 created, code reviewed/simplified, 15 review threads resolved, coverage improved from 68% to 96.4%, and deferred items documented.

repo: Worktree branch refs can desync from HEAD — after agent execution in isolation mode, the branch pointer may not update, requiring cherry-pick instead of standard merge
The gsd-verifier agent can produce false negatives if run before cherry-picked commits are visible in the working tree — spot-checks against disk/grep are the source of truth

encrypt.worker.ts was excluded from tsconfig.json but not included in tsconfig.sw.json — the worker was not being type-checked in CI; decrypt-sw.ts has its own tsconfig.sw.json and the encrypt worker should follow the same pattern
The codebase uses a structured logger rather than console.warn/log/error — raw console calls are flagged in code reviews
apps/web/CLAUDE.md contains guidance about Blob.buffer usage being incorrect; pre-existing violation in upload.service.ts
ESLint warnings in tests are treated as errors per user preference — `@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any` must be resolved with proper types even in test files
p-limit is the concurrency primitive used for bounded parallel operations in the SDK layer
BYO-IPFS pinFn wrapper (lines 869-876 in client.ts) discards secondaryWarning, so pin:secondaryFailed events do not emit for batch uploads — known gap

code.finding: originalSize must be captured BEFORE passing data as a Transferable — after transfer, params.data.length becomes 0
addFilePointerToFolder can throw on hash collision; wrapped in try/catch so a collision on one file doesn't abort the entire batch — partial success tracked in registeredSuccesses
Early return path when all registrations fail — was uncovered until batch test suite expansion
Batch-level errors (arrayBuffer failure, uploadFiles throw) left upload rows stuck in 'encrypting' state — outer catch needed to mark newFileIds as 'error'
encrypt.worker.ts added to include array so it's type-checked alongside decrypt-sw.ts in CI
Coverage expanded from 10 to 20 tests covering: partial failure, folder-publish failure, all-registrations-failed, BYO-IPFS pinFn, share re-wrap, and batchError String() branch

workflow: When gsd executor agents run in worktree isolation, always verify SUMMARY.md and git commits before treating as success — completion signals can be unreliable
False-negative verifier results require manual spot-checks (grep for key symbols, check file sizes) and direct VERIFICATION.md edits with justification
The /simplify skill surfaces design trade-offs (upfront buffer allocation, D-0X task comments, type deduplication) that should be explicitly acknowledged even when not fully fixable
PR review comments marked 'not applicable' should still be replied to with clear reasoning before resolving the thread
Deferred items from PR reviews must be added to phase CONTEXT.md and VERIFICATION.md — they won't be tracked otherwise
pnpm lint:fix auto-formats files but only treats no-explicit-any as a warning — must be manually fixed to zero warnings

friction: Worktree branch ref desync after agent execution required manual cherry-pick of 3 commits and reset of bad merge — root cause is worktree HEAD not updating the branch pointer
gsd-verifier produced false negatives for all Wave 2 artifacts, requiring extensive manual VERIFICATION.md edits across ~10 separate Edit calls
Accidentally ended up in the worktree directory after cherry-picking, causing confusion about which branch PROJECT.md changes were being applied to
Background task completion for STATE.md conflict resolution and phase completion commit arrived after the main flow had already moved on, causing minor confusion
Reply to threads 7-15 bash command failed on thread 15 due to jq parse error on non-JSON response — required retry
lint:fix auto-applied formatting changes that needed a separate commit after the main lint-fix commit was already made
open_items: Secondary pin warning not emitted in batch path — BYO-IPFS pinFn wrapper discards secondaryWarning, so pin:secondaryFailed events never fire for uploadFiles()
AbortSignal/cancel support for in-flight batch uploads — no way to cancel once uploadFiles() is invoked; requires SDK contract change
Lazy file reading within concurrency pool — currently reads all file ArrayBuffers upfront before p-limit pool starts; should accept File objects and read lazily to bound peak memory for large batches
Web E2E tests not updated for multi-file batch upload flows — existing tests cover serial single-file path only; batch drag-drop and progress during concurrent uploads untested in browser
Blob.buffer pre-existing violation in apps/web/src/services/upload.service.ts flagged by apps/web/CLAUDE.md guidance — not Phase 37 scope, should be fixed separately

BYO-IPFS pinFn lambda body (lines 869-876 in client.ts) remains uncovered by batch test suite — covered only via single-file upload tests since the lambda is passed through to mocked sdkCore.uploadFile
